preparation_steps.description: Dissolve ingredients except carbonate, bicarbonate, and thiosulfate, then sparge medium with 100% N2 gas for 30 - 45 min to make it anoxic. Add and dissolve carbonate and bicarbonate, adjust pH to 10 with KOH, then dispense medium under 100% N2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials and autoclave. Add thiosulfate to the autoclaved medium from an anoxic stock solution prepared under 100% N2 gas and sterilized by filtration. Adjust the pH of the complete medium to 9.8 - 10.0.
First dissolve nitrilotriacetic acid and adjust pH to 6.5 with KOH, then add minerals. Adjust final to pH 7.0 with KOH.

preparation_steps.description: Prepare the printed single stocks in purified H2O or NNM and sterilize each stock by autoclaving or 0.22 um filtration as specified.
Prepare the methyl-cellulose stock in cold H2O overnight before autoclaving; prepare the pectin stock in H2O with hot-plate stirring for 20 min before autoclaving.
Prepare 50 ml Mix solution 1 from the Si and Fe/EDTA stocks, fill with NNM, syringe-filter through 0.22 um, and store at 4 C.
Prepare 50 ml Mix solution 2 from the nitrate-phosphate stocks, fill with NNM, syringe-filter through 0.22 um, and prepare fresh each time.
Prepare 50 ml Mix solution 3 from the vitamin stocks, fill with NNM, syringe-filter through 0.22 um, and store at 4 C.
Prepare 50 ml Mix solution 4 from MEM 50X amino acids, MEM 100X amino acids, and the glutamine stock; fill with NNM, syringe-filter through 0.22 um, and store at 4 C.
Prepare 50 ml Mix solution 5 from glycerol and the carbon-source stocks, fill with NNM, vacuum-filter through 0.22 um, and store at 4 C.

preparation_steps.description: 1. After detergent cleaning, all glassware is rinsed thoroughly with glass-distilled water and then autoclaved.
2. To 900ml of glass-distilled water are added 100ml of 10X concentrate of CMRL 1066 without glutamine (Gibco Laboratories, GrandIsland, NY, No.330-1540).
Add the source-listed ingredients to the diluted CMRL 1066. The provider requests an addition order, but its item array is not accepted as that order; exact addition order remains unresolved here.
4. Adjust pH of medium at 20-25°C to 7.6 with 1 N NaOH.
5. Add 200ml of 7 percent gelatin (Difco) which had been dissolved in boilinig water.
6. Sterilize by filtration with air pressure (0.2 μm nitrocellulose, Millipore Corp., Bedford, MA). Store medium at 4°C.
7. Before use, add unheated rabbit serum(\"trace hemolyzed\"; Pel-Freez Biologicals, Inc., Rogers, AR) to a final concentration of 6 percent.
8. Dispense to glass or polystyrene tubes or bottles. Fill containers to 50 to 90 percent capacity and captightly.*

MediaDive solution 4801 / JCM Medium 837 lists 0.5 mg/L Resazurin.
MediaDive solution 4801 / JCM Medium 837 lists 925.0 ml/L Distilled water.
MediaDive solution 4801 / JCM Medium 837 lists 20.0 ml/L 1 M Sodium acetate solution.

MediaDive solution 4801 / JCM Medium 837 lists 10.0 ml/L Trace vitamins.
MediaDive solution 4801 / JCM Medium 837 lists 25.0 ml/L 8% NaHCO3 solution.
MediaDive solution 4801 / JCM Medium 837 lists 6.0 ml/L 5% Na2S x 9 H2O solution.

record.preparation_notes: Mix components thoroughly and autoclave under an N2 atmosphere. Add the sodium acetate, sodium fumarate, Trace vitamins, NaHCO3, and Na2S x 9 H2O solutions from sterile anaerobic stocks.
record.notes: MediaDive solution 4801 represents the main solution for JCM Medium 837. Stock-solution additions are kept as asserted ml/L solution rows because this SolutionRecipe record cannot nest the source stock compositions inline.

preparation_steps.description: Add and dissolve ingredients of solution A, adjust pH to 7.0, and sparge medium with 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture for 30 - 45 min to make it anoxic. Dispense medium under the same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes to 30% of their volume and autoclave. Solution B is prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere and autoclaved. Solutions C, D, and H are autoclaved under a 100% N2 gas atmosphere. Solutions E, F, G, and I are prepared under 100% N2 gas and sterilized by filtration. To complete the medium appropriate amounts of solutions B to I are added to the sterile solution A in the sequence as indicated.

Note: Some cultures are shipped in semi-solid medium which stimulates growth at the beginning. For agar stabs 3.00 g/l agar are added to the complete medium from a sterile anoxic stock solution (2% w/v). Upon receipt add anoxically 1 - 2 ml of the recommended freshly prepared liquid medium to the agar tube and incubate for 3 - 5 days . After incubation transfer 0.5 ml of the resulting cell suspension in the liquid phase to tubes with liquid medium.
First dissolve FeCl2 in the HCl, then dilute in water, add and dissolve the other salts. Finally make up to 1000.00 ml.

Rumen fluid from cow or sheep (obtained from fistulated animals or abattoir refuse) is filtered through muslin, autoclaved at 121°C for 15 min and then centrifuged at 27,000 g for 20 min. The supernatant is made anoxic by sparging with 100% N2 gas for 15 min, dispensed under same gas atmosphere into anoxic serum vials to 30% of volume and then stored frozen at -20°C.
Dissolve 0.1 ml of vitamin K1 in 20 ml 95% ethanol and filter sterilize. Store refrigerated in a brown bottle.

stored frozen at -20°C.

1. Add and dissolve ingredients of solution A, adjust pH to 7.0, and sparge medium with
80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture for 30 - 45 min to make it anoxic. Dispense medium
under the same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes to 30% of their volume
and autoclave. Solution B is prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere and
autoclaved. Solutions C, D, and H are autoclaved under a 100% N2 gas atmosphere.
Solutions E, F, G, and I are prepared under 100% N2 gas and sterilized by filtration. To
complete the medium appropriate amounts of solutions B to I are added to the sterile
solution A in the sequence as indicated.

2. Note: Some cultures are shipped in semi-solid medium which stimulates growth at the
beginning. For agar stabs 3.00 g/l agar are added to the complete medium from a sterile
anoxic stock solution (2% w/v). Upon receipt add anoxically 1 - 2 ml of the recommended
freshly prepared liquid medium to the agar tube and incubate for 3 - 5 days . After
incubation transfer 0.5 ml of the resulting cell suspension in the liquid phase to tubes with
liquid medium.


For DSM 103462: Replace the sugar mix of solution E with the sugar mix of medium 110a.

Clarified rumen fluid (from medium 1310)
Rumen fluid from cow or sheep (obtained from fistulated animals or abattoir refuse) is
filtered through muslin, autoclaved at 121°C for 15 min and then centrifuged at 27,000 g
for 20 min. The supernatant is made anoxic by sparging with 100% N2 gas for 15 min,
dispensed under same gas atmosphere into anoxic serum vials to 30% of volume and then
stored frozen at -20°C.

Clarified rumen fluid (from medium 1310)
Rumen fluid from cow or sheep (obtained from fistulated animals or abattoir refuse) is
filtered through muslin, autoclaved at 121°C for 15 min and then centrifuged at 27,000 g
for 20 min. The supernatant is made anoxic by sparging with 100% N2 gas for 15 min,
dispensed under same gas atmosphere into anoxic serum vials to 30% of volume and then
stored frozen at -20°C.
